content: Wa no sererge uridwa Ople doge gair kerkerge. Kai iako koka dataute: wa sererge baprekrawem!
Wa no uridwa wader leem debele. Ople pe maike dali.
Wa nole wader lu darakepwarawem ege no wabi erkepasamu, Agudi damsawem nalu wa laglag; gair amos waba wanagri no eswaukem.
Ia waiakai Agudi mapodange Iesu Kerisoi doge. Agudira mapodan au sikak wadikedawa pe nalu dike wabi idonige dike.

Mop maike kara mir, buai: nalu lu pe nagri agekar, nalu lu pe nagri amrem, nalu lu pe nagri barkak, nalu lu pe nagri puipikak a zogozogo, nalu lu pe nagri audebele, a nalu barkak lu wage darauspirawem - wa no able lu darakepwarawem.
Wa ge mena gair lu ikerarwem wa karialam berwerda a wage tadasmerda a tasorda kaka tikerer. Ege Agudide mapodan
Kaka wanali mokakalam lukak le a mokakalam able mitkar luglug le. Ka geka teberweri able gumik mapodanira ka nawer gair tonar utebge; lewer aroaro, lewer arokak; mitkar a nolekarge.
Ka umele gair lu akere Kerisoi doge pe kari kelar naiswerli.
Mena bakedida wa debele urder wa kara beber wa ikaidarda perper baida.
Wa Pilipaira le umele uridli able kikem kerkerge able debe mirira, ka Masedonialam bakiamuda, ege no wabi zogometade kari upinatida, kari neisweri a kage irpi.
Nade ka mena geka nawer Tesalonikage wage karim upiatidar emarikdarda neis kerkerge, ge kaka laglag nawer.
Ka nole koka lugem dasmeli; kape no laglag nali ka wabi auspireda ableglam wa aiswereda.
Ka kemerkemer bodomalam erpeida a dadgiko. Kara aumitkar nagri ableglam Epaprodaitaside kari neisweri able lu ge wawa temarikdarda. Pe nagri werteda debelaglag zegurlu.
Kari Agudide mari gair lu wanaiswer nalu ma laglag taba zoromlam moige Iesu Kerisoi doge.
Abim meriba Agud a Baba able zorom nagri niaiem niaikarem.
